title: FletcherDamageDoubler
description: An add-on plugin for Fletcher to modify the damage and to fix ghast fireball deflection.
body:
# FletcherDamageDoubler

FletcherDamageDoubler is an add-on plugin for [Fletcher](https://modrinth.com/plugin/fletcher) to modify the damage and to fix ghast fireball deflection.

There is a config file for configuring a damage multiplier for the arrows (default is 2). The config can also enable/disable arrow damage notifications, either above the hotbar or as a chat message.
